svg.title: Ontario resident ambulance co-payment of 45 dollars
svg.desc: One bar. The Ontario co-payment for an insured ambulance service is 45 dollars, from Ontario Regulation 365/19 and the City of Toronto ambulance-fees page. Other provinces are not plotted because an official fee page for them was not opened.
svg.text: Resident ambulance co-payment, sourced provinces only
Ontario only. Other provincial fee pages were not opened, so they are not estimated.
Insured person, co-payment of $45, Ontario Regulation 365/19 under the Health Insurance Act.
Toronto.ca: resident, valid health card, medically necessary, trip starts and ends in Ontario, no exemption.
Checked 27 Sep 2026. A higher charge for a non-resident was not copied from a hospital webpage.
